FloPlast Easyfit pipe clips provide secure and stable mounting for 68mm round downpipes. These black uPVC clips offer a quick installation process, as the downpipe can be added after the clips are fixed, requiring only one screw hole per clip for efficient installation. The design ensures compatibility with most major manufacturer’s downpipes, offering versatility without the need for lubrication. Ideal for new-build projects and property refurbishment work, where reliable downpipe support is essential for rainwater management.
